title: Upload Wait
summary: Lets people submit a form while attachments are still uploading: it queues the send, shows progress and submits when uploads finish.
description: Submit button for forms with uploads: pressing submit mid-upload validates and queues the send, the button fills with combined progress ("Waiting for 2 uploads…"), it submits by itself when they finish, a failed upload pauses it until retried, and leaving asks first.
catches: Submitting before attachments have uploaded (queued instead)
Failed uploads, which pause the send until retried
limits: Upload state comes from your uploads prop
The server must still reject submissions that reference missing files
a11y: Uploads list has an aria-label; retry buttons name the file
Status in a polite live region
Submit uses aria-busy while waiting or sending and aria-disabled once sent
Focus moves to Retry when an upload fails
server: Validate on the server that every referenced upload exists and finished before accepting the form.
